ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Conservation of General Collections] Class will meet in the Conservation Lab, 2nd floor of the Oak Street Library Facility, 809 S. Oak St., Champaign. A $30 non-waived course materials fee will be assessed to the student's tuition and fees bill. Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/programs/mbms/certificate1). See 590GN section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s).
